Three years ago today, 18 Mainers were killed and 13 more injured in the deadliest shooting in our state’s history.

It shook our community, our state and the entire nation. While time has passed, the painful sense of loss remains, especially for the families and friends who lost loved ones and for the victims who still carry the scars of that awful day.

But while the grief remains, my pride in my hometown does too. In the days and weeks after the shooting, Mainers showed up for one another. In the midst of the crisis, we had each other’s backs.

Today, Izzy and I are keeping the victims and their loved ones in our prayers. We will never forget the horror of October 25, 2023. But as we were then, we will remain: Lewiston Strong.

Our first responders do so much for our communities, but the job just keeps getting harder.

Maine’s population is aging, and that includes our first responders. If we don’t do something, we’re heading for a workforce crisis that could spiral into a healthcare crisis. We can’t afford that outcome.

Along with a bipartisan group of colleagues, I’ve proposed a number of solutions, including the PARA-EMT Act, which would establish a grant program to recruit, train and retain paramedics and EMTs in rural areas. It would also help veterans transition into civilian EMT careers.

We need solutions to keep Mainers safe in the future. Congress should act.

While Maine’s home heating prices have risen by 80% year to year, LIHEAP’s funding has increased by less than one percent.

With winter on the horizon, I’m urging Congress to plug the gap as soon as possible so that Mainers don’t have to face the cold alone.

I’ve joined @RepChrisPappas to request a supplemental $3 billion for LIHEAP, on top of the $4 billion already appropriated.

Every tribe in the nation is able to access federal programs and resources specifically intended for them — except Maine’s.

While we celebrate Maine’s tribes today, let us also recommit to the fight for sovereignty for our tribal neighbors. https://t.co/nyL4qPtbSf
Learn more about the comprehensive reforms in our bill here: https://t.co/NBBXbKao9Q
I’m proud our bill has the support of the @HouseBlueDogs and the support of @CRFB, @ConcordAction, @PPI and the Peterson Solutions Fund.

💰Tackle the out-of-control debt
🚫End government shutdowns
⚖️Strengthen checks and balances and bipartisanship
🗓️Make Congress pass budgets on-time

Americans deserve fiscal stability and responsible government, but the nation’s skyrocketing debt and ailing fiscal health are making life more expensive for families and threatening the prosperity of future generations.

It’s time to do something about it. 🧵
More info here: https://t.co/OZFpBsICEr

Dental care is healthcare. Plain and simple.

Yet those who served our country, and now live in remote or rural communities, often struggle to access reliable dental care.

That’s why I’m teaming up with @RepJackBergman, @Congressman_JVD and @RepDonDavis to help vets who aren’t able to afford or access a dentist get the care they need.

I’m confident this first step will do a lot of good.

Thrilled to see nurses at my local hospital, Central Maine Medical Center, vote to unionize.

Nurses banding together won’t just mean better working conditions for them, but better care for our community.

Unfortunately, 20 nurses were fired or suspended during the union drive. As @chelliepingree and I wrote to Prime Healthcare, the hospital's owner, anti-union retaliation and intimidation are illegal.

I call on hospital management to swiftly recognize the union and bargain in good faith. I’m heartened to know that now that they’ve won their union, nurses will begin organizing not only for themselves and their patients, but to reinstate any workers wrongfully punished for exercising their rights.

Congratulations again to the nurses in Lewiston on winning their union!
